collection.description: A Heathen will lead the camp's song of names for the first time, and a friend offers to help.

description_variants.description: An Isolan will lead the camp's song of names for the first time, and a friend offers to help.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: At the encampment there is a song that only gets sung on the longest night of the dry season. It is a song with a lot of names in it. (subject) has been asked to lead it this year for the first time, and (subject.he/she) is worried about getting a name wrong. (friend) has offered to stand beside (subject.him/her) and help.

o1.name: Outcome A
o1.text: They sing it side by side. (subject) stumbles once, and (friend) carries the line until (subject) finds it again. Nobody minds. Afterwards an elder tells (subject) that the song has been sung with mistakes in it for as long as she can remember, and that the names never seem to mind either.

o2.name: Outcome B
o2.text: (subject) spends the whole afternoon by the stream, singing the names to the water until (subject.he/she) has every one. When the night comes, (subject.he/she) sings it without a single mistake, and is surprised to find (subject.his/her) voice shaking anyway, on a name (subject.he/she) never even knew.
